title: CWP/18130/2024 of MALA Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND ANR
text:
§ IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 230 Date of decision : 27.11.2025 Mala ....Petitioner Vv/S State of Punjab and another .... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NAMIT KUMAR Present: Mr. H.S. Sidhu, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Surya Kumar, A.A.G., Punjab. Mr. Deepanshu Mehta, Advocate for respondent No.2. sea ek NAMIT KUMAR, J. (ORAL)

1. The petitioner has filed the instant petition under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India, seeking a writ of certiorari, for quashing the order dated 12.06.2023 (Annexure P-9) passed by respondent No.1, whereby the petitioner has been transferred from Garhshankar, District Hoshiarpur to Rampur Phull, District Bathinda. Further, seeking a writ of mandamus, directing the respondents to post the petitioner as Counsellor, Civil Hospital, Hoshiarpur as the post of Counsellor is vacant there.

2. After arguing the case for sometime, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that another post of Counsellor is vacant at Bhugna Centre and the petitioner may be permitted to withdraw the present petition to enable her to make a detailed representation to respondent No.2 for her adjustment at the said centre. I

3. If any such representation is submitted by the petitioner within a period of two weeks from today, the same shall be considered and disposed of by respondent No.2 within a period of one month thereafter by passing a speaking order. Further, the decision taken thereon shall be conveyed to the petitioner.

4. Disposed of in the above terms. 27.11.2025 (NAMIT KUMAR) kothiyal JUDGE I
